ModMetaData.name: Animal Gear - Null Outfit 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 compatibility tweak for Animal Gear. Player animals default to an animal-only None/无方案 outfit state. Animals with None do not run apparel optimization or search for apparel. Colonist outfit behavior is untouched.
